title: Framing a zoom shows one box, and the pointer says what it will grab
goal: While a zoom region is picked, the picture shows the zoom box and the clip's own selection handles at once, so there are two boxes and nothing says which one a press will move. Framing a zoom should show only the zoom box, with the pointer changing over its corners and body, and Escape should let the zoom go.
notes: Left rough by a-zoom-region-that-frames-a-spot-and-can-follow (audit 2026-09-30-zoom-regions). Box presses are handled in CanvasNSView via zoomBoxUp/onZoomBoxDown (CanvasPointerDrags.swift) and drawn by ZoomBoxOverlay (hit testing off), so the cursor cue belongs in CanvasPointerCue.toolCursor and the handles in the canvas selection chrome when editorState.showsZoomBox. Seen in /tmp/photonz-playtest/a-zoom-follows-the-cursor-walk/1-zoom-added-box-on-the-picture-sc.png.
acceptance: With a zoom picked and the transport stopped, the clip's own selection handles are not drawn; only the zoom box is
The pointer shows a resize cursor over the box's corners and a hand over its body
Escape lets a picked zoom go
A walk at Next defaults photographs the framing state with one box

log.note: Reproduced: /tmp/photonz-playtest/a-zoom-is-shaped-by-hand-walk/0-zoom-added-sc.png shows the clip's dashed frame, 8 handles and rotate knob drawn round the zoom box. Review before building: a Premiere/FCP editor framing a zoom (FCP's Ken Burns / Transform onscreen controls) sees ONLY the control being edited; Photoshop's crop hides the layer's transform box too. Plan: hide clip chrome while the box is up, one tested hit test in core (corner/body/beside) read by both the press and the pointer, crosshair beside the box (a drag there draws a new box), Escape lets the zoom go but keeps the clip picked (one step back, like leaving a group), and Escape mid-drag puts the box back.

left rough (no task, nits): on a dark recording the dim outside the box barely shows; the hand stays open while carrying the box; a press off the clip while framing only lets the zoom go (deliberate, so hidden clip handles are never grabbed blind). a-zoom-is-shaped-by-hand-walk could not run (screen locked, rightClick/windowDrag); its corner drag is covered by the new walk's lock-safe drag.

While a zoom is picked the clip's outline/handles/knob/motion chrome are hidden (CanvasDisplay, gated on zoomBoxUp); pointer reads ZoomBoxHit (new, PhotonzCore, tested): resize on corners, hand on body, crosshair beside; Escape lets the zoom go and keeps the clip picked, or puts a box drag back. Verified by framing-a-zoom-shows-one-box-walk at Next defaults (green under a lock, 2 real captures; control runs with the fix off fail on the outline and on Escape), Scripts/test.sh 10904 passed.
